Method of Attack: Used code from legitimate Telegram messenger with added scripts for persistence and loading URLs from command server
Runs malicious service in foreground to avoid being killed by system
Respawns service after termination with timer
Contacts command servers to receive URLs, browser user agent to mask origin, and JavaScript codes
Serves different websites based on device geographical location (IP address), including scam sites, adult content, and games
Potential click fraud via loaded JavaScript codes
Endless loop requests to same website causing battery drain and possible device crash
Attack Vector: Installation from Google Play Store and redirection from third-party repositories to Google Play
Automatic start after device boot and app install/update
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious URLs served based on IP geolocation
Telemetry detections mostly in U.S., Iran, India, UAE, Germany
